digest.component_or_area: live Jira Cloud S3-backed multi-project test suite
propositions: A read-only S3-backed live test suite for multi-project Jira Cloud reconciliation against real projects REB and DIG must be created and gated in CI as a separate manual-dispatch job.

The suite must enforce read-only semantics structurally by monkeypatching all 18 mutating AcliClient methods to raise, with verification that the guard is non-vacuous and per-project Jira counts remain identical before and after.
The suite must validate that compute_snapshot fetches both REB and DIG projects at real volume (thousands of issues) with correct per-project attribution into a single isolated S3-backed store.
The suite must validate that bridge_preview in DRY_RUN mode produces zero outbound Jira mutations (total=0 create=0 update=0 delete=0) and correctly fails closed when given an unknown project key.
The suite must validate that the S3 store's projects.json mapping survives a git push/clone round-trip via git-remote-s3, and that per-project fetch scoping prevents cross-project contamination.
